title: Gov role login redirects to government dashboard
description: Verifies a successful login for a government user lands on the government portal dashboard.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify the user lands on the government dashboard

title: Farm role login redirects to farm dashboard
description: Verifies a successful login for a farm user lands on the farm portal dashboard.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify the user lands on the farm dashboard

title: Invalid credentials show login error
description: Verifies the login form shows an error when credentials are invalid.

steps.description: Fill 0000000000 into the national id field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Verify a login error message is visible

title: User without matching portal role is redirected back to login
description: Verifies a user who cannot be routed to a portal ends up back on the unified login page after attempting login.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify the user is on the unified login page

title: Gov dashboard loads primary widgets after login
description: Verifies the government dashboard displays its primary KPI and overview sections once authenticated.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify map and alerts overview sections are displayed

title: Navigate from gov dashboard to map view and see map rendered
description: Verifies a logged-in government user can reach the map view and the map content renders.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Click the navigation item to open the map view
Verify a map of wells is displayed
Verify geographic overlays or markers are displayed

title: Non-gov session attempting gov dashboard is denied or redirected
description: Verifies users without the government role cannot access the government dashboard and are redirected to the unified login page.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify the user is on the unified login page

title: Farm user lands on farm dashboard and sees primary content
description: Verifies a farm user can access the farm dashboard and key widgets render.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify the user lands on the farm dashboard
Verify the dashboard content such as weather and KPI widgets is displayed

title: Navigate from farm dashboard to quota view
description: Verifies a farm user can navigate from the farm dashboard to the quota management view and see quota content.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Click the navigation item to open the quota view
Verify the quota management view is displayed

title: Session without farm assignment attempting farm dashboard is redirected
description: Verifies users without a farm assignment cannot access the farm dashboard and are redirected to the unified login page.

steps.description: Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the national id field
Verify the user is on the unified login page

title: Well detail route is not directly accessible via static routes list
description: Ensures tests do not attempt to navigate to a dynamic well detail route that is unsupported for static-route UI automation.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view wells or well details if present
Verify there is no way to open a specific well detail page without selecting a well id from the UI

title: Government map page loads primary well map content
description: Validates the closest static alternative to well detail rendering by ensuring the government wells map view renders its primary content after login.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to open the map view
Verify a wells map is displayed
Verify well markers or well-related map content are displayed

title: Government distribution page loads primary content
description: Confirms the government distribution view loads and shows distribution-related content after authentication.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to open the distribution view
Verify distribution data or a distribution table is displayed

title: Government dashboard loads primary portal content
description: Ensures the government portal dashboard loads successfully after login and shows core dashboard content.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to open the dashboard
Verify the government dashboard primary content is displayed

title: AI plan page loads and can request a plan (happy path)
description: Logs into the farm portal, requests an AI irrigation plan, and verifies a plan result is displayed with key fields visible.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to open the AI plan page
Verify an irrigation plan result is displayed
Verify total litres and per-zone recommendations are displayed

title: AI plan request shows reasoning and traceability details
description: Requests an AI irrigation plan and verifies the plan includes reasoning and traceability-related information visible in the UI.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to open the AI plan page
Verify prompt or traceability details are displayed

title: AI plan can be requested repeatedly and updates results
description: Requests an irrigation plan twice and verifies that the UI updates to show a new/latest plan result without requiring a page refresh.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to open the AI plan page
Verify the irrigation plan result is displayed after the second request

title: AI plan unauthenticated access is blocked by login requirement
description: Attempts to use the AI plan feature without being authenticated and verifies the UI requires login before allowing a request.

steps.description: Attempt to request an irrigation plan
Verify an unauthorized state is shown requiring the user to log in
